metadata.title: Setup guide — Nebula
metadata.description: What to prepare, how to install, and the first settings to check.

page.paragraph_2: What to prepare, how to install, and the first settings to check.
page.paragraph_3: These instructions cover the upcoming update. The current public download is v1.0.2.

before.paragraph_1: You need your own copy of Super Mario Galaxy. Nebula does not include or download game files. Setup prepares your game locally on your computer.
before.cell_5: About 5 GB for Nebula and the game
before.cell_6: Super Mario Galaxy (SMG2 is not supported)
before.cell_7: ISO, RVZ or an extracted game folder
before.paragraph_2: The supported disc includes English, French and Spanish. Other regions are currently not supported or planned. A tested minimum CPU/GPU list and recommended hardware tiers will be published with the release.

install.paragraph_3: Run Nebula Setup and select your game file. Setup checks the game and revision before importing.
install.paragraph_4: Choose Install. Setup prepares the game on your PC and adds Start menu shortcuts. Keep the installer for updates and repairs.
install.paragraph_5: Open Nebula from the Start menu. Adjust the launcher’s Display, Graphics, Controls or Audio options, then choose Save and play.
install.paragraph_6: Download only from the project’s releases. If Windows or your antivirus flags a file, check the release notes and ask for help in Discord.

first-launch.paragraph_1: After choosing a save file, press
first-launch.paragraph_2: to open settings. On Xbox, use View + Menu; on PlayStation, Share + Options; on Switch, Minus + Plus. You can also open settings from the pause menu.
first-launch.item_1: Start at a low internal resolution on older PCs, then increase it until you are happy with performance.
first-launch.item_2: Set the aspect ratio to Auto. Use Display for HUD resolution to keep menus and text sharp.
first-launch.item_3: Try native interpolation for a high-refresh display.
first-launch.item_4: If your PC can handle ray tracing, start with Low or Medium, then adjust resolution or use DLSS / FSR 3 if needed.
first-launch.item_5: Use Apply to keep changes, or Undo to discard them. Display changes have a confirmation countdown.

updates.paragraph_1: Nebula will check for updates at launch and you can update to the newest version while keeping your save data. You can also run Setup again to update, repair, restore the previous version or uninstall. Uninstalling keeps your saves and settings.
updates.paragraph_2: Before a major update, close the game and export a save backup from the launcher’s Advanced tab.

footer.paragraph_1: A little closer to the stars.
